x-bump-note: 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 adds four optional properties: pm_decision (enum apply|defer|reject, written by the EM after the central route run from the PM's ruling -- per-record or per-cluster, a cluster ruling writes the same value to every row sharing the ruled-on cluster id, and the EM records that cluster id) plus the engine closer's status/closed_at/closed_by triple written when an outbox row is applied. Purely additive -- every document valid under 1.0.0 still validates here, none of the four fields is required. RE-VENDOR: the engine vendors this schema too and needs this shape to read pm_decision == apply and to write the closure triple; hold declared per DR-097 until the engine repo re-vendors.
description: Lessons-outbox artifact — a universal-scope lesson routed by coordinator-lesson-promote toward a central-wiki fold-in. Stored per-lesson in state/lessons-outbox/<topic>.yaml (whole-document YAML — no prose markdown body).

id.description: Stable identifier for this lessons-outbox entry.

created.description: Timestamp this entry was authored. Producer coordinator-lesson-promote stamps _now_iso() date-time; field matches producer reality — do not narrow to date-only.

change_kind.description: The kind of change this lesson recommends downstream.

target_wiki.description: The wiki (or other doc surface) this lesson should fold into.

title.description: Short human-legible title for this lesson.

body.description: Full prose content of the lesson.

scope_tags.description: Optional classification tags for this lesson.

evidence.description: Optional supporting evidence (path, quote, or reference) backing this lesson.

pm_decision.description: The PM's ruling on this row, written by the EM after the central route run. Ruled per-record or per-cluster: a cluster ruling writes the same value to every row sharing the ruled-on triage cluster id. The apply run selects rows where pm_decision == apply.

status.description: Written by the engine closer when this outbox row is closed.

closed_at.description: Timestamp the engine closer closed this outbox row.

closed_by.description: Identifier of the engine closer (or session) that closed this outbox row.
